name: APFA Canonical Curriculum Architecture
purpose: Canonical bridge between educational source repositories and the APFA curriculum platform.

courses.title: Data Science
courses.description: Learn how data is collected, prepared, analyzed, visualized, communicated, and applied to real-world problems.

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.description: Learn the foundations of machine learning, including regression, classification, clustering, NLP, time series, and reinforcement learning.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Explore the foundations of artificial intelligence, neural networks, computer vision, natural language processing, deep learning, and intelligent systems.

courses.title: Generative AI
courses.description: Learn how modern generative AI systems work and how to responsibly build applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI security.

courses.title: Cybersecurity
courses.description: Learn core cybersecurity concepts including security principles, identity, networking, SecOps, AppSec, infrastructure, data, and AI security.
